summary: The factory has a brick dado under its sheeting, glazing high along its sides and back, gutters and downpipes, bollards either side of the shutter, a personnel door with a canopy, and gas bottles and drums against its walls. Its chimney is now a guyed steel boiler stack.
rationale: Appearance change of the factory's walls and chimney: matched studio stills from the front and the back show the dado, glazing, rainwater goods and clutter; a close-up sheet cut from the same renders shows the brick stack replaced by the guyed steel stack.
